entry.title: Video: How Much Softmax Do LLMs Need?

link.title: Video: How Much Softmax Do LLMs Need?

entry.content:
Watch on YouTube

This video walks through the two papers behind my written explainer:

  • Approximating Softmax in Pretrained LLMs: Model Sensitivity and Kernel Acceleration: which parts of softmax a frozen pretrained LLM actually depends on, and how that turns into a faster attention kernel in FlashAttention-4.
  • Pretraining Transformers with Quantized Softmax in Attention: what changes when a transformer is trained with a coarse, quantized softmax from the start.

Prefer reading? The full written version with interactive figures is at How Much Softmax Do You Need in LLMs?
entry.summary: A short video explainer of my two softmax papers, covering what pretrained LLMs need from softmax and what changes when you train with a coarse one.
